d:
The Supreme Court heard a case on firecracker pollution in Delhi-NCR and questioned authorities over the enforcement of rules for green crackers during Diwali last year. The court stressed strict implementation of existing rules and public awareness, while raising concerns about regular crackers being sold as green crackers and the use of barium-based crackers. The court has not proposed a complete ban at this stage but warned that stricter action may be needed if the rules are not enforced.
